create_DPDataLoader: create a DPDataLoader instance with a rank, dataset, batch size, and number of workers for distributed data loading
test_DPDataLoader: test the DPDataLoader class initialization with an iterable dataset and distributed data parallel rank
build_DPDataLoader_state: build a checkpoint state dict from a DPDataLoader instance for distributed training resumption
restore_DPDataLoader_state: restore a DPDataLoader instance from a previously saved checkpoint state dict
review_DPDataLoader: review the DPDataLoader class for distributed data parallel state management and checkpoint compatibility
